messages.subject: capture graphics
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am building a custom UI with a command line in a webpage, so that users can type any commands they want (while shiny does the communication to and from the server).

I am now struggling to find a solution to:
- detect if some of the commands open up a graphics device
- capture it
- show it in the UI

If my understanding is correct, I can't use renderPlot() because the plotting commands are not server specific but UI specific (the user types those commands).

Any suggestion is welcome, particularly if there is anything shiny-specific that I am not aware of.

Best,
